caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped decorative plate with a floral and fruit motif, centered on a cream-colored background. The plate is predominantly black, bordered by two circular rings: the outer ring features alternating gold and white floral patterns interspersed with small clusters of red berries, while the inner ring is gold. Within the plate, the central composition shows two yellow and green birds perched among an abundance of fruits and leaves. The fruits include a cluster of purple grapes, a cluster of red berries, a green apple, a golden peach, and a red strawberry, all surrounded by large green leaves. The colors used are primarily yellow, green, red, purple, gold, and black. The artist's signature, "Chas. Roadman," is written below the plate on the cream background.
title: Tray
